body:
Fixed on `3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6`: the exact placeholder stays open until deletion returns, its child link is checked before pre-rename/rename-failure cleanup and before a successful hook can allow destination overwrite, and failed identity/unlink cleanup joins the original cause plus contextual cleanup cause and poisons revision maintenance. Successful cleanup returns the original error and permits retry. Rebound regular files/directories and the canonical revision survive.

The actual changes are [retained authority and cleanup](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6/TreeDB/db/leaf_manifest_revision_gc.go#L334-L366) and [eight regressions](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/3182e15dfe1aa11120db9d309ad0d590283398d6/TreeDB/db/leaf_manifest_revision_gc_5066_test.go#L385-L503), including real permission-denied unlink, both failure paths, hook-return-nil destination rebound, cause propagation, evidence preservation and poisoned retry refusal. Exact clean tested source52bc2147 passes focused normal12.986s/race14.609s/vet; current integration preserves those runtime/test blobs. Final retained D cost and current-head review/CI remain separate gates.
